Chipotle Black Bean Tacos

PREP10 min
COOK15 min
TOTAL25 min
DIFFICULTYEasy

Beans

  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 yellow onion, diced
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 tsp ground cumin
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 2 chipotles in adobo, minced
  • 2 cans black beans, drained
  • ¼ cup water
  • 1 tsp kosher salt

To serve

  • 12 corn tortillas
  • ¼ red onion, quick-pickled
  • ¾ cup cotija, crumbled
  • 1 bunch cilantro
  • 2 limes, cut into wedges
  1. 1
    Build the base

    Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook the onion 5 minutes until the edges catch color. Add garlic, cumin and smoked paprika and stir 30 seconds until fragrant.

  2. 2
    Simmer the beans

    Add the chipotles, beans, water and salt. Simmer 8 minutes, mashing about a third of the beans against the side of the pan so the whole thing thickens and clings.

  3. 3
    Char the tortillas

    Toast the tortillas directly over a gas flame or in a dry cast iron pan, 20 seconds a side, until blistered. Stack them in a towel to steam soft.

  4. 4
    Assemble

    Spoon beans onto each tortilla and top with pickled onion, cotija, cilantro and a hard squeeze of lime.

COOK'S NOTES The mash step is what separates this from beans on a tortilla. For vegan tacos, swap cotija for toasted pepitas and a spoon of cashew crema.
